data: NVIDIA's revenue rose from about $26.97 billion in fiscal 2023 (the year ended January 29, 2023) to about $130.50 billion in fiscal 2025 (the year ended January 26, 2025). That is an increase of roughly $103.5 billion, or about 384%, meaning revenue grew nearly fivefold over the two years. Most of the jump came in fiscal 2024, when revenue reached $60.92 billion (up 126% from fiscal 2023), followed by a further 114% rise in fiscal 2025, driven largely by data center demand for AI accelerators.
